rv.q: A thrillingly original new musical... directed with vibrant panache by Stevie Walker-Webb.
Arrives as one of the most invigorating and promising new musicals of the last several seasons.
The combination of a compelling story, great music, and a dream team of a cast makes this essential.
An often breathtaking musical as big as its ambitions, and as fun-loving as its gun-toting heroines.
Every member of the cast captivated the audience with an enthusiastic performance that will not soon be forgotten.
A 150-minute in-your-face reclamation of power that could very well end up on Broadway soon.
A fresh and vibrant sound that resonates with audiences of all backgrounds.
Gun & Powder is a memorable theatrical experience, a fun twist on a Western, that will leave you humming and wondering, what would you have done.

cn.t: Critics enthusiastically praise "Gun & Powder" as a thrillingly original musical, highlighting its powerful exploration of identity and heritage, outstanding performances by Ciara Renée and Liisi LaFontaine, and richly compelling storytelling.
